FunkThemes  (2026-10-17)
========================

Try it: double-click "Theme Maker.html". It opens in your browser, nothing to install.

What's new
- Animated backgrounds: ASCII smoke (a fluid sim, your mouse stirs it), Matrix, Synthwave, Starfield, Rain.
- They react to the music in Funk's apps (bass, mids, highs, beats). Press "Fake music" in the
  Theme Maker to see that without an app.
- Sliders for effect speed, amount and colour. New presets: Terminal Mist, Green Code, Amber Terminal.

Sharing themes
- In the maker, Export saves a .funktheme file. Send it to a friend.
- To use one in every Funk app (Claude Watch, FunkStudio...), put the .funktheme file in
      %LOCALAPPDATA%\FunkThemes
  (paste that into the Explorer address bar). The "themes" folder here has Funk's own.
- Or press "Import .funktheme" in the Theme Maker.

Files
- Theme Maker.html            the stand-alone maker
- funktheme.js                the theme engine + editor (the same file the apps use)
- themes\                     Funk's saved themes
- for-developers\themes.py    the shared theme-library code the Python apps use
